stem.text: Molten aluminium chloride has a simple molecular structure. Each molecule consists of two aluminium atoms and six chlorine atoms.

A.text: All the chlorine atoms in $1\ \text{g}$ of molten aluminium chloride have the same mass.

B.text: One mole of molten aluminium chloride contains $6.02 \times 10^{23}$ aluminium atoms.

C.text: One mole of molten aluminium chloride contains $3.61 \times 10^{24}$ chlorine atoms.

D.text: The empirical formula of molten aluminium chloride is $\text{Al}_2\text{Cl}_6$.
